scenario.name: GRIDWISE LAB 园区能源协同优化试点
scenario.audience: 园区运营总监、能源经理、财务与生产负责人
scenario.decision: 是否批准 72 万元、12 周的受控试点
scenario.disclaimer: All business, operating and financial values were authored as synthetic research data.

dashiTheme03.reason: The locked theme uses electric blue #2742EC and lime #C2F53D. Exact navy/cyan tokens require a new or extended theme pack.
dashiTheme03.chartEditability: The v4 chart is exported through SVG/image fallback; ten chart labels are extracted as editable text.
dashiTheme03.pptxFallbacks: Each selected slide contains at least one theme SVG fallback.

directProgrammaticBaseline.chartEditability: Slide 4 uses one native editable bar chart.
directProgrammaticBaseline.pptxFallbacks: One authored hero image is intentionally raster; all other content is native text, shapes or chart objects.

efficiencyComparison.dashiStrength: Creates and validates 32 candidates from one canonical eight-slide content package, with deterministic allocation and reusable export checks.
efficiencyComparison.directProgrammaticStrength: Produces the exact requested palette and native chart with fewer fallback objects, but only one design route and requires explicit layout programming.
notMeasured: General AI PPT service production time or cost

conclusions: Dashi is not distinguished by a single visual style; its defensible value is candidate generation, canonical-content mapping, full-deck allocation, validation and multi-format export.
A branded image and decision-grade narrative make the selected v4 deck materially stronger than a generic research deck, but the locked theme still cannot meet an unrelated brand palette exactly.
For repeated standardized decks, the 3+1 candidate workflow and validation pipeline offer more leverage than one-off direct authoring.
For exact brand reproduction and guaranteed native chart editability, direct programmable authoring is currently the stronger route unless Dashi receives a custom theme and export recipes.
PowerPoint rendering and object inspection remain mandatory because browser-valid layouts can still change through font wrapping or SVG fallback.
